cohort: 58 women undergoing non-emergent cesarean delivery at >= 37 weeks of gestation were randomized to an enhanced recovery after surgery protocol, and 60 were randomized to standard care.
finding: Enhanced recovery after surgery at cesarean delivery was not associated with an increase in the number of women discharged on postoperative day 2 but was associated with a significantly reduced postoperative length of stay, improved patient satisfaction, and an increase in breastfeeding rates.
